scope: compiler-generated TinyStories-1M consolidated external-memory RTL; transaction-level model only

simulator_optimization_probe.model_recompiled: generated Verilator C++ with OPT_FAST=-O3; RTL and memory model unchanged
simulator_optimization_probe.interpretation: Compiler optimization changed throughput by less than two percent; generated RTL evaluation, not driver compilation, dominates.

state_probe.interpretation: The memory arbiter continues to make progress and the consolidated token-bank controller is idle at these checkpoints; no request deadlock or unmatched response was observed. The dominant cost is the generated core/arbiter evaluation rate, with the consolidated bank path not active in these sampled states.

execution_profile.interpretation: The simulator spends nearly all sampled time repeatedly evaluating one generated combinational assignment, indicating a delta-cycle/event-scheduling explosion in the compiler-generated control graph rather than a DDR transaction deadlock.

verilator_without_timing_scheduler.interpretation: The manually clocked transaction wrapper does not need delayed-event scheduling, but disabling Verilator timing improves throughput only modestly.

registered_q_output_enable_experiment.interpretation: Registering the profiled q_output_q16_16 content enable is slower and was not adopted; it was a diagnostic experiment, not an RTL change.

single_nba_iteration_shortcut.interpretation: Forcing Verilator to execute only one NBA iteration skips required sequential updates and produces no memory traffic; it is not semantically valid.

disabled_mux_x_to_zero_experiment.interpretation: Replacing 345 disabled-path 'x mux arms with zero does not improve runtime and changes the request trace versus the baseline (2866 requests); four-state don't-care behavior is not assumed equivalent.

q_output_enable_cse_experiment.interpretation: Factoring the q_output static-read predicate into a wire does not improve runtime and changes the bounded trace versus the baseline; this generated design is sensitive to control scheduling and the CSE is not promoted.

interpretation: The consolidated path does not show a response mismatch or adapter error. The bounded probe demonstrates very low transaction-level simulation throughput; the long run stopped at the last observed checkpoint after no log progress for more than seven minutes. This is neither first-token success nor a hardware/PCIe/physical-DDR3 claim.
next_action: Instrument the first state/request transition where consolidated simulation progress collapses before rerunning full inference.
